title: Distance converter with form card
request: Distance converter between km and mi (1 mi = 1.609344 km). If the message has a number and a unit ('5 km' or '3 mi'), reply 'X km = Y mi' or 'X mi = Y km' with Y rounded to 2 decimals. If the unit is missing, reply 'Which unit?' with a form card that has a number field named 'value', a select field named 'unit' with options km and mi, and a Convert submit button whose selection is {"action":"convert"}. When the submitted form arrives as JSON (e.g. {"action":"convert","value":"10","unit":"km"}) convert it the same way.
